title: A trust strip on the Shipped page: verified by running, sent back, reverts this week
description: A real browser on the built dashboard: with seeded deliveries, proofs, send-backs and a batch-gate revert, the Shipped page's trust strip shows three numbers for the last seven days — the share of delivered items whose proofs ran the real app, the share sent back for rework, and the reverted items — matching those records, with no agent counts; each number filters the Shipped page to the items behind it, and a delivery older than the week counts for none of them.

steps.name: the trust strip's three numbers, no agent counts, and the links to its items
